# Surgery understanding outputs (generated by the AI; no human labels)

- `narration/narration_<video>.json`: running commentary of held-out surgery, written by `narrate.py` from **accepted labels only**. Each sentence cites the decision rows it rests on; `lanes/integrity.py` fails if any sentence lacks accepted evidence. Shown as subtitles in Watch mode (`web/watch.html`).
- `phases/<video>_phases.json`: the surgical phase the AI assigned to each annotated frame (e.g. "2. Calot's (Hepatocystic) Triangle Dissection"), with its confidence. Produced by `localize.py`.

Generated offline and played back; real-time narration is the next step.
